answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Filed deep sea diver certification with commercial diving attestation. It requires a certification diving officers renew after assessed dives, so the karst of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the dune first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The jetty is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
